case.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?

reply.answer:
Here's the difference between the two machines:

**Get Clássica** — the traditional card machine:
- Physical buttons (models S920 and SP930)
- Prints receipts on thermal paper (bobina)
- Connectivity: data chip + Wi-Fi
- Accepts swipe (magnetic stripe), chip, tap (NFC) and Pix
- Made from recycled material
- Rental: R$ 79.90/month if you don't reach the minimum sales volume; free depending on your sales bracket (e.g., from R$ 2,000/month and R$ 10,000/month in the zero-rental offer)

**Get Smart** — the most modern and complete terminal:
- Touchscreen display
- Readers for chip, magnetic stripe and contactless (NFC)
- Connectivity: 4G (with free data plan), Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
- Smart features: stock control, placing orders, closing the bill, uploading a menu and issuing electronic invoices (NF-e) directly on the machine, plus integration with your system (TEF)
- Aimed at CNPJs with monthly sales above R$ 10,000
- Rental: R$ 129.90/month if you don't reach the minimum sales volume; discounts by bracket; free from R$ 60,000/month in sales per machine

In short: the **Get Clássica** is the simple, button-operated machine with paper receipts; the **Get Smart** is the touchscreen terminal with management features (stock, NF-e, TEF) for larger businesses.

Com base na base de conhecimento da Getnet, segue a comparação entre a **Get Clássica** e a **Get Smart**:

## Get Clássica
- **Modelos**: pode variar em até 4 modelos, com a mesma tecnologia. O manual cita os modelos **S920** e **SP930** (diferença nas funções dos botões, como limpar informações, avançar bobina, confirmar/cancelar operações, ligar/desligar e abrir tela de função).
- **Uso**: maquininha de cartão tradicional (manual de uso com funções de botões, configuração de Wi-Fi, venda, estorno etc.).
- **Aluguel**: se não atingir o faturamento mínimo, o valor de utilização é **R$ 79,90/mês**. Fica grátis conforme faixas de faturamento (a oferta de aluguel zero cita Get Mini ou Get Clássica para vendas a partir de R$ 2 mil/mês e R$ 10 mil/mês).
- **Taxas (exemplo da oferta de aluguel)**: Débito a partir de 1,69%; Crédito 1x 3,79%; 2x 7,98%; 3x 8,47% ... até 12x 12,88%. As taxas podem variar conforme condições contratadas.

## Get Smart
- **Modelo**: POS 3G + Wi-Fi (4020-4011).
- **Características**: tela touchscreen, leitor de chip, leitor de tarja magnética, leitor sem contato (NFC), comunicação 4G, Wi-Fi e Bluetooth, chip 4G com plano de dados gratuito.
- **Funções diferenciais** (sistema de gestão integrado):
  - Consulta de estoque diretamente na máquina, sem deslocamento;
  - Dispensa computador e impressora fiscal (faz as duas funções);
  - Fazer pedido, fechar conta e emitir cupom fiscal no terminal;
  - Conciliação com pagamentos em todas as modalidades: crédito, débito, crediário, QR Code e dinheiro.
- **Público**: exclusiva para **CNPJ com faturamento acima de R$ 10 mil/mês**.
- **Aluguel**: se não atingir o faturamento mínimo, o valor integral é **R$ 129,90/mês**. Há descontos por faixa de faturamento (ex.: acima de R$ 2 mil, desconto de até R$ 14,90; acima de R$ 10 mil, até R$ 79,90; acima de R$ 60 mil, até R$ 159,80; acima de R$ 300 mil, até R$ 319,60). Com faturamento acima de **R$ 60 mil/mês por máquina**, o equipamento é **gratuito**.
- **Benefícios da oferta**: maquininha grátis (mediante vendas a partir de R$ 60 mil), conta e cartão grátis, recebimento em 2 dias (via Get Conta), taxa única nas principais bandeiras.

## Resumo da diferença
A **Get Clássica** é a maquininha tradicional (com botões, modelos S920/SP930), mais barata no aluguel (R$ 79,90/mês sem atingir faixa). A **Get Smart** é um terminal com tela touchscreen e sistema de gestão integrado (estoque, cupom fiscal, conciliação), voltada a CNPJs com faturamento acima de R$ 10 mil/mês, com aluguel de R$ 129,90/mês se não atingir as faixas — e gratuita a partir de R$ 60 mil/mês de vendas.

case.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?

reply.answer:
Receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis) works like this:

- **How it works:** Since June 7, 2021, Banco Central Resolution 4.734 and Circular 3.952 set the rules for using card receivables in credit operations. Getnet registers the receivables with a Registradora, and the "gravame" mechanism directs your receivables schedule to the financing bank as a guarantee (this replaced the old "Trava de Domicílio Bancário").

- **Rates:** There is no fixed published rate. The rate is the one practiced by Getnet on the date of each anticipation and can be consulted in the Getnet service channels. For PAT (meal/refeição) voucher transactions, a differentiated rate applies — under the new PAT rules, for voucher-function transactions the anticipation rate is the same as the credit rate.

- **How to use it:**
  1. Santander account holders: at a bank branch with your account manager, or via Internet Banking (Empresarial, if enabled).
  2. Automatic/eventual anticipation: via the Getnet Call Center (Central de Atendimento Getnet).
  3. Anticipation via POS: directly on your Getnet machine.
  4. Non-Santander account holders: use the Call Center or the POS.

- **Conditions to know:**
  - You can cancel automatic receivables advance at any time, but cancellation does not cover receivables already processed for early payment.
  - Getnet may limit or suspend the advance at any time without notice.
  - You remain responsible for the legitimacy of sales and for debits, chargebacks and cancellations even after the advance; in that case you must reimburse Getnet with 1% monthly interest plus IGPM/FGV monetary correction.
  - If you negotiate receivables with another financial institution, conditions are negotiated directly with that institution.

Sources: Getnet knowledge base, "antecipação de vendas"; Getnet contract clause 18.7 and PAT knowledge base item.

args.request: How does receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis) work with Getnet? Rules, rates and how to use it.

evidence.result:
Here's what the Getnet knowledge base says about receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis):

## How it works
- Since June 7, 2021, Banco Central Resolution 4.734 and Circular 3.952 set the conditions for merchants to use their card receivables in credit operations. The acquirer must register the receivables with a Registradora so they become a financial instrument that can be negotiated. *(Source: "antecipação de vendas" – site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/antecipacao-de-vendas/)*
- **Gravame** is the mechanism that replaced the "Trava de Domicílio Bancário": when you negotiate a credit contract with a financial institution using your receivables, your receivables schedule is directed to the bank to guarantee the operation. *(Same source)*

## Rates
- The anticipation rate is the one **practiced by Getnet on the date of each anticipation** and can be consulted in the Getnet service channels — the knowledge base does not publish a fixed number, so it can vary. *(Source: "Contrato de Credenciamento aos Serviços Getnet e Outras Avenças", clause 18.7)*
- For **PAT (meal/refeição voucher)** transactions: if you anticipate your receivables, a **differentiated rate** is applied; under the new PAT rules (published Nov/2025), for voucher-function transactions the anticipation rate remains the same as the credit rate. *(Sources: "O Programa de Alimentação do Trabalhador (PAT)" and "Getnet | Cartões")*

## How to use it (channels)
- **Santander account holders:** at a bank branch with your account manager, or via Internet Banking (Empresarial, if enabled).
- **Automatic / eventual anticipation:** via the Getnet Call Center (Central de Atendimento Getnet).
- **Anticipation via POS:** the establishment itself performs the procedure on the Getnet machine.
- **Non-Santander account holders:** use the channels above (Call Center / POS).
- Negotiation of receivables with Santander or a Getnet partner institution can also be contracted through Getnet service channels. *(Source: "antecipação de vendas" and the consolidated contract, clause 19.1.1)*

## Rules and conditions (from the consolidated contract)
- You can **cancel automatic receivables advance at any time**, but the cancellation does not cover receivables already processed for early payment (clause 18.8).
- Getnet may **limit or suspend** the contracting of receivables advance at any time, without prior notice (clause 18.9).
- Formalization requires meeting Getnet's validation and security requirements (passwords, data confirmation, authorization for call recording, etc.) (clause 18.10).
- You are responsible for the **legitimacy of the sales** and for debits, chargebacks and cancellations even after the advance; in that case you must reimburse Getnet with **1% monthly interest plus IGPM/FGV monetary correction**, which may be deducted from your financial schedule, debited from your bank account or charged via boleto (clause 18.11).
- If an irregularity is found after payment, Getnet may request a debit from your bank account or issue a boleto (clause 18.14).
- If you negotiate receivables with another financial institution, the conditions are negotiated directly between you and that institution; Getnet only settles the transactions in the bank account registered with the Registradora (clause 19.1).

**Note:** The knowledge base does not give a specific rate value — the rate is set per anticipation date and varies, so check the current rate in the Getnet app, Portal Minha Conta or Central de Atendimento.

case.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?

reply.answer:
With the crediário, you can split a sale into **up to 48 installments** — that's the product's limit. Two details to keep in mind:

- The maximum number of installments may be lower depending on the card issuer (the bank that issued your customer's card).
- Crediário sales are paid to you in **up to 2 business days** after the transaction is captured, in a single payment — regardless of how many installments the customer chose.

Source: Getnet "Folder_Credirio.pdf" (site.getnet.com.br).

case.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?

reply.answer:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp using Getnet’s Payment Link (Link de Pagamento).

Here’s how it works:

1. You generate a payment link with the products or services you want to sell.
2. You send that link to your customer via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or SMS.
3. Your customer clicks the link, chooses how to pay (debit, credit, Pix, Wallet, or boleto), and completes the purchase.

Nice extras:
- You can add several products in one cart.
- You can personalize the link with the product image.
- You can include freight/shipping charges.
- You get Getnet’s Antifraude protection.
- You can sell to foreigners using their RNE document.

The Link de Pagamento is included at no extra cost in the e-commerce packages (Recorrência Essencial and Recorrência Flexível). Activation happens the same day, and both wholesale and retail merchants can use it.

One point: recurrence/agendamento features are available only for credit card.

Source: Getnet knowledge base (site.getnet.com.br link de pagamento FAQ).

args.request: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Getnet Payment Link (link de pagamento)? How does it work?

evidence.result:
Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Getnet Payment Link (Link de Pagamento). Here's what the Getnet knowledge base says:

**How it works**
- The seller can send the Payment Link to customers via social networks, **WhatsApp**, email and SMS. The customer clicks the link, chooses the payment method and completes the purchase (source: "Link de pagamento" FAQ, site.getnet.com.br/duvidas/link-de-pagamento/).
- You can sell from wherever you are using WhatsApp or your social network (source: "Getnet | Link de Pagamento: venda mais online", site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento/).

**Features of the Link de Pagamento**
- You can include several products in the same cart ("carrinho").
- The link is customizable — you can personalize it with the product image.
- It includes Getnet's Antifraude (fraud protection).
- You can choose to let the buyer pay by debit, credit, Pix, Wallet or boleto.
- You can include a shipping/freight charge.
- You can also sell to foreigners using their identification document (RNE).
- The Link de Pagamento is included at no extra cost in the e-commerce packages (Recorrência Essencial and Recorrência Flexível), and all e-commerce packages give the right to use the Payment Link.
- Activation (habilitação) happens on the same day.
- Both wholesale (atacado) and retail (varejo) merchants can have the Payment Link.

**Note:** The recurrence engine (agendamento de cobranças, retentativa inteligente, etc.) is available only for credit card, per the package documents.
